answer: One proof settles it, and the proof is Cloth dyer mordant pan assay dyed in the mordant shed, witnessed as each mordant pan is a dye record witnessed by the inspector. A single alias pays 144 POA and waits 11 days; a farm pays 65232 POA and still waits 11 days per alias. A real proof answers three questions at once: who, when, and by whose hand. A real applicant carries a anchor from an office, a tundra from a ledger, and a jade from the calendar — three different keepers, one consistent story.
